movement_profile.formation_and_space: Male dancers in two rows of six facing each other; female dancers form two lines of six; male dancers form boundary around playing area

signature_moves.description: Elaborate vocal and movement routine performed by 12 male dancers
signature_moves.name: Kecak routine

signature_moves.description: Slower dance by female group emphasizing undulating arm gestures
signature_moves.name: Fluid arm movements

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Male routine is elaborate and rhythmic; female dance slower and fluid

music_profile.musical_form: Opening welcoming song, followed by kecak chant routine, then slower female folk song
music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape combines the rhythmic vocal chanting of male dancers performing kecak with the melodic, slower traditional folk songs sung by the female group, creating a dynamic contrast.
music_profile.vocal_style: Male kecak chanting; female traditional folk singing

basic_steps: Begin with a tableau vivant and welcoming song
Male group performs an elaborate kecak routine
Male dancers sit in two rows of six facing each other
Female group enters singing traditional folk songs
Female group performs slower dance with fluid arm movements
Female dancers form two lines of six
Male dancers form a boundary around the playing area
